forbidden.name: packages-not-to-apps
forbidden.comment: Packages should never import from apps.

forbidden.name: no-cross-app-imports
forbidden.comment: Apps should not import from other apps.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Files without any dependencies to or from them. Ignored for config and type files.

forbidden.name: not-to-test
forbidden.comment: Production code should not import test code.

forbidden.name: L0-no-upward
forbidden.comment: Layer 0 (Base) should not import from higher layers.

forbidden.name: L1-no-upward
forbidden.comment: Layer 1 (UI) should not import from higher layers.

forbidden.name: L2-no-upward
forbidden.comment: Layer 2 (Infrastructure) should not import from higher layers.

forbidden.name: L3-no-upward
forbidden.comment: Layer 3 (Domains) should not import from Layer 4.

forbidden.name: standalone-isolation
forbidden.comment: Standalone packages should have ZERO dependencies on Layer 3 or 4.

forbidden.name: L0-L1-subpath-only
forbidden.comment: For Layer 0 & 1, direct imports from the root index are discouraged. Use subpaths for heavy items (e.g., @repo/ui/icons).

forbidden.name: independent-api-boundary
forbidden.comment: Independent/Public packages must be accessed only via their public API (index.ts).
